subject: Repricing for Q3 capacity increase — proposal and SLA exception
messages:
From: Alex Singh <alex.singh@fintera.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: procure@fintera.com
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Q3 capacity increase + pricing guidance

Hi Karthik,

We're planning to ramp model usage ahead of a new product launch and expect a ~2.6x increase in GPU hours starting July 1. Can you share a short proposal/quote for a 6‑month capacity increase? Specifically:
- Target: +2.5-3.0x baseline throughput (estimated 160K tokens/day to 420K tokens/day)
- Need visibility on short-term discounts and any one‑time onboarding/ingestion credits you can provide
- We'd like a temporary price hold for the first 90 days of the increase if possible (we're trying to lock budget while load stabilizes)
- Also flag any SLA exceptions required for p95 latency under burst traffic — our engineering lead needs to know if there are constraints

I've attached last 30 days of usage to help (fintera_usage_may.csv). Targeting a quick turnaround — can you get a draft by EOD tomorrow?

Thanks,
Alex Singh
Head of Platform, Fintera Labs
Alex.Singh@fintera.com
Attachment: fintera_usage_may.csv (CSV, 34KB)
From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Alex Singh <alex.singh@fintera.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 13:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Q3 capacity increase + pricing guidance

Alex — thanks for the context and the attachment. Quick read-through is helpful.

High level proposal (will follow with a formal PDF):
- 6‑month uplift: commit to 2.5x baseline with tiered discount schedule (5% at 2.0x, 9% at 2.5x, 12% at 3.0x)
- One-time ingestion/onboarding credit: $7,500 applied to first invoice (covers data transfer and onboarding work)
- 90‑day temporary price hold: we can hold the agreed per-token rate for 90 days from activation, then revert to blended committed rate
- SLA exception for p95 latency during the first 30 days of heavy burst traffic: propose an addendum rather than changing platform SLAs; ops will document mitigations and fallbacks

Attachments: I'm sending a first-draft quote (kIyer_fintera_quote_v1.pdf) to the thread. Marissa/Monica — looping you for pricing/legal sign-off and to confirm the onboarding credit level and SLA wording.

Next steps: if this aligns, Alex — we will prepare an amendment + DocuSign for your procurement team and include the 90‑day price hold clause.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
Attachment: kIyer_fintera_quote_v1.pdf (PDF, 28KB)
From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com, Alex Singh <alex.singh@fintera.com>, procure@fintera.com
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 10:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Q3 capacity increase + pricing guidance

On Mon, May 17, 2027 at 1:04 PM karthik_iyer@redwood.com wrote:
> High level proposal (will follow with a formal PDF):
> - 6‑month uplift: commit to 2.5x baseline with tiered discount schedule (5% at 2.0x, 9% at 2.5x, 12% at 3.0x)
> - One-time ingestion/onboarding credit: $7,500 applied to first invoice
> - 90‑day temporary price hold
> - SLA exception for p95 latency during first 30 days: addendum

All — quick internal notes and recommended adjustments before we send an executable amendment: 
1) Discount structure: simplify to two breakpoints to reduce invoicing complexity — 7% at >=2.3x, 11% at >=2.8x. Keeps economics close but fewer tiers.
2) Onboarding credit: increase to $10k (covers priority integration support + dedicated runbook) — we'll absorb incremental ops cost for strategic expansion accounts.
3) Price hold: agree to 90 days but cap the total token volume eligible for the hold at a conservative uplift threshold (so we don't over-subsidize sustained overages). Propose 120% of the uplift baseline as the cap.
4) SLA exception: Legal will want clear rollback triggers and an engineering remediation timeline (we can offer a 30-day exception window; if p95 doesn't stabilize, auto-fallback to a higher-priority routing that restores baseline latency guarantees).

I've attached a short amendment draft to capture the SLA language and cap logic (proposed_amendment_draft.docx). Monica — please advise on finance approval for the $10k credit and the cap logic.

If Fintera confirms this approach, we'll issue a clean amendment + updated quote and send via DocuSign.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Head of Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
Attachment: proposed_amendment_draft.docx (DOCX, 15KB)
From: Alex Singh <alex.singh@fintera.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: procure@fintera.com
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Q3 capacity increase + pricing guidance

Marissa / Karthik — this reads well and addresses our main risks. A few quick confirmations from our side: 
- Accept the two-breakpoint discount approach (7% / 11%)
- Agree to the $10k one-time onboarding credit
- The 90-day price hold with the 120% uplift cap is acceptable
- SLA addendum: engineering will review the proposed language but the 30-day exception window with rollback triggers is acceptable in principle

Please send the updated quote + the amendment as a single package to procure@fintera.com. We prefer DocuSign for signatures. If you can get the DocuSign link to us by EOD tomorrow our PM will slot the approvals for an expedited turnaround.

Thanks — Alex
Alex Singh | Head of Platform, Fintera Labs
Attachment: none
